Name: Claude Deck
Description: Claude Code on the Ulanzi Deck: live status pet, answer questions from the deck, and a big-screen session display.

Actions.Name: Claude Pet
Actions.Tooltip: Live Claude Code status: coding, asking, or idle. Press to jump to the session needing you. Grey icon = no Claude Code session detected.

Actions.Name: Claude Option Next
Actions.Tooltip: Cycle through the options Claude is asking about (shown on the big key). Grey icon = no Claude Code session detected.

Actions.Name: Claude Option OK
Actions.Tooltip: Answer Claude with the option currently shown on the big key. Grey icon = no Claude Code session detected.

Actions.Name: Claude Screen Setup
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle Claude status on the big screen. Press = automatic (Studio restarts itself).

Actions.Name: Claude Session Switch
Actions.Tooltip: Cycle which Claude session the big screen shows (one way, wraps around). Grey icon = no Claude Code session detected.

Actions.Name: Claude Compact
Actions.Tooltip: Compact the top Claude session's context. Press once to confirm (eyes), press again to run /compact. Grey icon = no Claude Code session detected.

Actions.Name: Claude Session Screen
Actions.Tooltip: The big-screen display: session name, status, and the question picker.

Actions.Name: Claude Clear
Actions.Tooltip: Wipe the top Claude session's conversation history. Press once to confirm (eyes), press again to run /clear. Grey icon = no Claude Code session detected.

Localization.bigscreen_title: Claude status on the big screen
Localization.bigscreen_help: Press this key to toggle the big screen between Claude status and the built-in widget. Ulanzi Studio restarts itself to apply (~15 s). A backup of the page is saved automatically. If Studio removes the big-screen display after you edit the page, the key shows the loading animation — restart Studio to reapply.
Localization.pet_dir_help: Leave empty to show combined status of every Claude Code session. Set a project path to watch only that one. Press = jump to the session needing you.
Localization.terminal_help: Global choice — used by all Claude Deck keys.
Localization.terminal_help_cycle: Global choice — used by all Claude Deck keys (session display, jump, answering).
Localization.hint_install: Claude Deck drives Anthropic’s Claude Code CLI. Open the User Guide for the install steps, then come back.
Localization.hint_enable: Turn on tracking so the deck can see your sessions, then restart any running claude sessions.
Localization.hint_update: This version registers the hooks differently. Update them, then restart running claude sessions.
Localization.hint_denied: macOS is blocking terminal control. Allow Ulanzi Studio under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.
Localization.hint_check: Check terminal access once: answering the macOS prompt now avoids a key that silently does nothing later.
Localization.hint_waiting: All set. Start a claude session in your terminal and the keys come to life.
Localization.tracking_help: Adds hook entries to your Claude Code settings (~/.claude*/settings.json, backup saved) so the deck can see session status. Restart running claude sessions afterwards.
Localization.grey_legend: Black-and-white keys mean no Claude Code session is being tracked. A key with an amber dot means Claude Deck still needs setting up. The keys return to colour as soon as a session is detected.
